Plan A (Maximum Security - Recommended).name: Maximum Security & Zero-Trust
Plan A (Maximum Security - Recommended).description: Complete remediation: Customer KMS CMK encryption, 0.0.0.0/0 ingress revocation, CIS Level 1 OS scripts, and least-privilege IAM binding.
Plan A (Maximum Security - Recommended).trade_offs: Takes ~2 minutes to bake a fresh Golden AMI, but delivers 100% Zero-Trust posture.

Plan B (Fast Network Quarantine Lockdown.name: Fast Network Quarantine Lockdown
Plan B (Fast Network Quarantine Lockdown.description: Revokes public ingress rules without re-encrypting underlying EBS volumes.
Plan B (Fast Network Quarantine Lockdown.trade_offs: Instant (<30s), but leaves unencrypted data at risk at the storage layer.

Plan C (Regulatory Baseline Hardening).name: CIS & KMS Compliance Baseline
Plan C (Regulatory Baseline Hardening).description: Enforces KMS storage encryption and CIS SSH hardening for compliance audits.
Plan C (Regulatory Baseline Hardening).trade_offs: Satisfies regulatory compliance checks while leaving existing security groups intact.
